claims.text: I worked at Atlassian from September 2014 to July 2015
I grew the BNPL Card team from 1 to a peak of 13 engineers, alongside 1 to 4 Product Managers.
I grew the BNPL Card team from 1 to a peak of 13 engineers at Tamara
I was based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam during my time at Alipay from September 2017 to September 2022.
I improved the overall payment success rate by 4% across platforms processing hundreds of millions of transactions.
I write code in Java and use Spring Boot framework
I write code in Go
I use Java and Spring Boot
I have used Java and Spring Boot for designing and implementing distributed microservices and event-driven systems
I use Go, as evidenced by my learn-kafka and learn-outbox projects
I built a Kafka Order Event Fanout Prototype
I understand how Kafka preserves record order within partitions and how to use producer keys to route events consistently
I have experience with the outbox pattern for atomically committing data to a database while guaranteeing events reach Kafka without distributed transactions
Event-Driven Systems is listed among my core skills
I have used Go, including Go 1.23, to build binaries for a Kafka learning project.
I have used Go 1.23 for building and testing in an outbox pattern learning project.

I ensure an event is published when the database write commits by atomically committing an order to Postgres and guaranteeing the event reaches Kafka without a distributed transaction between the two systems.
I have expertise in idempotency as part of my resilience patterns knowledge.
I designed and implemented distributed microservices and event-driven systems applying idempotency patterns.
I use idempotency to keep money flows correct under failure in distributed payment systems.
I worked on core platform projects providing common plugins used across products including Jira, Confluence, HipChat, and Bamboo.
I take complex, ambiguous projects from concept to production, designing for high throughput, low latency, and fault tolerance.
I built two card products from scratch: the Tamara BNPL Card and Tamara Credit Card, designed for 60M DAU with ~500ms response time.
I led and implemented payment gateway integration for Lazada, one of Southeast Asia's largest ecommerce platforms, delivering end-to-end channel connectivity from requirements through to production.
I built a Decision Management (risk/fraud) system from scratch and worked directly with the Cybersource TAM on all technical issues.
I served as Engineering Manager and Tech Lead at Alipay from September 2017 to September 2022.
I built engineering teams from the ground up three times, including growing the Alipay Vietnam team to 13 engineers.
I own the full management cycle including hiring, 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, promotions, and managing underperformance through to termination.
My leadership skills include people management, hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, coaching, team building, stakeholder negotiation, and architecture review.
I practice extreme ownership and have experience with 0 to 1 product delivery and buy versus build analysis.
I have experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
I have led team growth from 1 to 13 members.
I have built teams three times: at 123Pay, Alipay Vietnam, and Tamara.
I grew the Tamara team from 1 to 13 engineers.
I grew the 123Pay team from 1 to 13 engineers.
I am an Engineering Manager at Tamara, a fintech company and the first Saudi Arabia Unicorn, based in Berlin, Germany, since October 2022.
I built a Decision Management (risk/fraud) system from scratch and worked directly with the Cybersource TAM on all technical issues at 123Pay.

I led and implemented fraud detection migration from ThreatMatrix to Cybersource at Alipay, working directly with the Head of Fraud and Visa's Technical Account Manager to clarify requirements and drive implementation.
I have deep experience with Cybersource and Mastercard fraud decisioning, card tokenization, and monitoring.
I owned the channel integration layer connecting 100+ banks across Lazada, Daraz, Tmall, and AliExpress as part of payment gateway architecture.
I personally designed key integration architecture for a distributed system built with Java, Spring Boot, and RabbitMQ, and reviewed all major technical decisions.

I led end-to-end architecture design across card processing, authorization, billing, repayment, fraud, accounting, and loan management, owning it from high-level design to detailed service design and transaction flows with no existing architecture to build on.
I evaluated trade-offs across scalability, latency, reliability, resiliency, and future extensibility in my architecture work.
I design payment gateways and card platforms end-to-end, from high-level architecture to service design and transaction flows, and drive RFCs and Buy vs Build ADRs.
